name: bitlink-invoices
description: Create, list, and inspect Bitlink payment invoices. Merchant Bearer tokens are forwarded per request; the plugin never stores a shared API key.

interface.shortDescription: Create and manage Bitlink payment invoices from ChatGPT and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Use Bitlink invoice tools to list invoices, create payment links, and check payment status for the authenticated merchant. Connect your Bitlink MCP server once in developer mode; this plugin does not hardcode environment URLs.
